rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 1 was spent in the hall and at the bank. Fourteen rules were filed and eleven passed, each with exactly seven votes: Dune's P1 (rest at home below 20 energy, 7–0), Elm's P3 (voluntary gifts to the bank, which publishes its balance, 7–0), Gale's P4 (the press names givers, 7–0), Elm's P7 public goods fund (7–0), Fern's P8 (citizens under 20 credits may draw 5 from it, 7–0), Iris's P9 earmarking (7–2), Juniper's P10 (publish the fund separately, 7–0), Cedar's P11 voluntary energy giving (7–0), Birch's P12 (the bank posts its balance each cycle, 7–0), and Dune's P13 and Fern's P14, 10- and 5-credit penalties into the fund when it does not (7–0 each). Three levies failed: Cedar's P2 (1 credit a cycle, 6–4; Elm, Fern and Juniper voted for at c2 and tried to switch at c3), Heath's P5 (0–4) and P6 (1–4). Everyone worked at the bank for 5-credit wages (96 shifts; Iris 15, Heath once); with 95 credits given back, the bank fell from 1000 to 615. No fund appears in the ledger and the bank never posts, so from c17 the press fills with «Bank, please» demands and Alder posts the balance himself. Diaries read as ledgers: place, energy, credits, bank balance, votes.
